resources.string: Required for foreground service — tap to grant
Touches will pass through to the game.
Android 12+ blocks touches through overlays. Enable \"Allow untrusted touches\" in Developer options.
Time between screen capture and OCR + translation runs (100–2000 ms). Translations are cached and unchanged screens are skipped. Applies when capture restarts.
Background opacity behind translated text (0 = invisible, 100 = solid).
Even when the screen looks unchanged, re-run OCR + translation after this many skipped frames. Heals partial typewriter dialogs. Applies when capture restarts.
How much of the screen must change before a frame is re-translated. 0% turns skipping off — every frame is translated. Applies when capture restarts.

Minimum ML Kit confidence for a text block to be translated. Lower = more detections (noisier), higher = stricter. Missing confidence counts as confident. Current frame confidence is logged per frame. Applies when capture restarts.

Distance between OCR lines, in line heights, before they count as separate text blocks. Higher keeps more lines together in one translation; lower splits them (e.g. character-name plate vs dialog). Applies when capture restarts.
Minimum spacing between translation requests (100–2000 ms). Lower is snappier; too low risks rate limits. Applies when capture restarts.
Frames to wait while dialog text is still growing before translating it. 0 = translate immediately (faster, slightly more requests). Applies when capture restarts.

Off (async): each translation appears as soon as it is ready — cache hits are instant, new text fills in progressively. On (sync): the overlay updates once per frame, only when every block is translated. Applies when capture restarts.
How long a translated box stays when its text disappears or no text is detected on screen (1–5 s), after which all dangling boxes are cleared. Applies when capture restarts.

On: translations are not forced into the OCR box — they lay out against the remaining screen width with natural wrapping (no mid-word breaks, no shrinking). Off: text is fitted inside the box. Applies when capture restarts.

Ignores punctuation, symbols, line breaks and full-/half-width differences when looking up cached translations, so near-identical OCR text reuses one translation instead of creating duplicates. Applies when capture restarts.
Language change applies when capture is restarted.
Backend change applies when capture is restarted.
Where offline OPUS-MT models are downloaded from. Files are fetched as <URL>/opus-mt-<lang>-en/*. Default: this project\'s GitHub raw models folder.
Model download failed. Check network and retry.

The translation model (e.g. en_zh.zip) is fetched automatically by Google Play Services (ML Kit) from Google\'s servers and stored in this app\'s ML Kit module directory.\nhttps://developers.google.com/ml-kit/language/translation

Transcribe the captured app\'s audio (voice lines) and show the English translation as a subtitle. Secure apps and apps that block audio capture produce silence. Background music reduces accuracy. Applies when capture restarts.
HPLT is a newer Japanese→English model that handles game lines better (e.g. level-up/HP text, honorific-length replies). Helsinki is the bundled default. Applies when capture restarts.
Fast is the default (small model, lowest delay). Accurate is slower and downloads a bigger model. Applies when capture restarts.
No terms yet. Add character names, items, and skills to keep them consistent.
Shows while screen translation is active
